dedupe_keys.name: trechos de drenagem em terras da uniao

description: Trechos de Drenagem em Terras da União is a dataset listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). Este dado compreende os trechos de drenagem localizados no interior de Áreas Protegidas cujos Recursos Hídricos são de Domínio da União, extraídos da Base Hidrográfica Ottocodificada (BHO), versão Multiescalas 2013, segundo o que determina o Artigo 20, Inciso III, da Constituição da República Federativa do Brasil de 1988. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Base Hidrográfica Ottocodificada, Trecho de Drenagem, Terra da União, Unidade de Conservação, Terra Indígena. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
